subject: Azure Partner Center: field seller outreach & account stitch playbook
messages:
From: Jordan Smith <j.smith@contoso.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Azure Partner Center referral / field seller alignment for Contoso pilot

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the intro at Ignite last week — Contoso is excited to get the pilot live and we wanted to start the referral/field alignment conversation so we can hand the first 50 accounts to Azure sellers with minimal friction.

TL;DR: Can you send the recommended account mapping format and a simple outreach play we can use with our sellers? We have a list of pilot accounts and a preferred Contoso contact per account. We also need to understand how Partner Center consent and seller ownership will be represented when the referral flows through.

Quick context: we'll be doing an initial co-sell push focused on manufacturing vertical accounts in West US. Contoso will own customer conversations, but we need Azure seller engagement for co-sell motions and incentives.

Proposed timing: workshops next week (Mar 1–4).

Primary contact for this work: Jordan Smith (me) — j.smith@contoso.com / +1-206-555-0198

Appreciate any templates or sample mapping files you can share.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Smith
Sr. GTM Manager, Cloud Partnerships
Contoso
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <j.smith@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center referral / field seller alignment for Contoso pilot

Jordan — great to hear and congrats on getting initial accounts scoped. Putting the playbook below and attaching three files you can use immediately.

Attachments (stubs):
- contoso-account-map-v1.csv (csv) — columns: account_name, azure_tenant_id, contoso_primary_contact, contoso_owner_email, last_activity_date, preferred_region, vertical_tag
- rdw-contoso-mutual-action-plan.docx (docx) — 1-page MAP template for pilot milestones and responsibilities
- azure-pc-seller-consent-guidelines.pdf (pdf) — short explainer on Partner Center seller consent flow and seller attribution

High level play (30k ft):
1) Account stitch: we'll ingest your CSV and run an account reconciliation that matches on tenant + name + domain. Any contested matches will be surfaced back to your team with a suggested owner based on last_activity_date.
2) Seller attribution: Azure seller consent is required at intake. Our suggested default: if Azure seller has explicit consent in Partner Center, they get primary co-sell attribution; otherwise the Contoso owner remains primary and we route to Azure for low-touch outreach.
3) Outreach: we recommend a two-step seller outreach — (a) internal seller heads-up (1 paragraph + PSA), (b) seller intro email template that copies Contoso primary contact and asks for a 15-min intro call.
4) Escalations: any contested accounts or PR/enterprise-level customers flagged for joint owner review. Escalation path: (1) Seller AM, (2) Contoso GTM lead, (3) RDW partner lead.

Proposed next steps (pick one):
- We run a quick ingestion (we need the CSV) and share the reconciled mapping by EOD Mar 1.
- 30-min alignment workshop Mar 2 or Mar 3 (we can do 10:00 PT or 15:00 PT).

If you confirm the CSV, I'll kick off the ingestion and invite Karthik (owner: intake automation) + Vanessa (owner: co-sell ops) to the workshop. Ben will own the outreach templates and enablement doc.

Sample outreach snippet you can use to loop in Azure sellers: 
"Hi <SellerName>, Contoso is launching a pilot in your region with 10 accounts that match your portfolio. Can we schedule a 15-min intro to align on technical fit and co-sell next steps? Contoso contact: Jordan Smith (j.smith@contoso.com)."

Best,
Chloe Martin
Head of Partner GTM (Americas)
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Smith <j.smith@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: field seller outreach & account stitch playbook

Appreciate the notes, Chloe. Quick notes from intake automation perspective:

- Matching precedence: 1) exact tenant_id, 2) verified domain match (email domains), 3) recent sales activity (last_activity_date). We'll mark fuzzy matches for manual review.
- Contested accounts workflow: create a single 'ownership ticket' in our intake tracker (link shared below) and notify both Contoso GTM and Azure seller. Ownership ticket auto-escalates after 48 hours if not acknowledged.
- Consent and seller attribution: our ingestion flags accounts lacking Partner Center consent and creates an outreach task for the assigned Azure seller (we can auto-send the intro if you approve).

Operational asks for Jordan: please add tenant IDs where available (speeds reconciliation). If you can't provide tenant IDs, include an admin contact and domain.

I'll attach an intake checklist (we'll drop the checklist into the Drive folder). Linking the intake tracker: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cContosoOnboarding

On the workshop: Mar 2 at 10:00 PT works for our ops team. I'll be on the invite and will demo the ingestion run live.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Smith <j.smith@contoso.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: field seller outreach & account stitch playbook

Chloe / Karthik — thanks, this looks great.

Confirming: we'll send the CSV with tenant IDs where possible by EOD today. Mar 2 at 10:00 PT for the workshop is perfect.

A couple quick asks:
1) Can you surface a short list of contested-account candidates (top 10) during the workshop so we can resolve them live?
2) For the outreach flow, can Redwood auto-send the initial seller heads-up or do you want Contoso to send it? (we prefer Redwood to send if possible)

Also — please add Contoso to the HubSpot deal you referenced (RDW-2027-9981) so our commercial team sees the intake stage.

Thanks again — Jordan
Jordan Smith
Sr. GTM Manager, Cloud Partnerships
Contoso
